grouping_rule: issue_id = 'ISS-' + topic for every completed record whose intent is complaint or cancellation; one issue per review

issues.name: Users unable to log into accounts
issues.description: The examples describe users being locked out of their accounts through login errors, logouts, phone number rejections, and false no-connection messages, with some losing access to saved content and playlists.

issues.name: Free users blocked from choosing or replaying songs
issues.description: Examples describe free-tier limits such as capped skips, no song selection within playlists, no repeat or loop, and navigation problems after an update, all frustrating basic playback control.

issues.name: Music playback stops or fails unexpectedly
issues.description: Reviewers report playback that randomly stops mid-song or show, shows a black screen, or says it is playing without producing audio, often requiring reinstalling or restarting the app to recover.

issues.name: Downloaded content disappearing or failing to sync
issues.description: The examples report downloaded music and offline content vanishing, failing to save, or getting stuck during download, often after storage changes or app backgrounding.

issues.name: Missing songs and artists in catalog
issues.description: Reviewers report that favourite songs, regional music such as Bollywood tracks, and previously available content are missing or removed from the app's catalog, and some report songs playing unexpectedly or only short clips.

issues.name: Premium purchase flow fails or blocks access
issues.description: Several examples describe users who cannot complete a premium subscription purchase, see a blank or pause screen after paying, or find free features restricted so the app feels unusable without premium.

issues.name: support problems
issues.description: contacting support, response time, quality of support answers

issues.name: Recent update removed features and broke app
issues.description: Several reviewers call the app worst or useless, with the most specific complaints tying the decline to a recent update that removed features or needs rework.
